In an outer loop it watches the pending-input count at a1+106; when that is at most 1 it refills via TextBufferDecompressor and breaks when no input remains. It accumulates counts into a1+98, compares against the target a1+82 plus v3, and when the produced run is short enough (or the buffer status flag at *a1+16 is set) it encodes the remaining run with HuffmanBitStreamEncoder, advances a1+82, and copies via BufferCopyWithSizeTracking. On input exhaustion and a nonzero a2 it emits the final residual (encoding end-of-data when a2 equals 4) and returns a status code: 0 when the buffer status field is clear and a2 is not 4, 2 when clear and a2 equals 4, otherwise 2*(a2==4)+1.
